svg.aria-label: Formify: Exam photo and signature generator that runs in the browser. Turns a selfie and a signature photo into exam-form-compliant files for GATE, JEE, NEET and UPSC. Segmentation and face landmarks run on-device; nothing is uploaded. 459 unit tests, 0.8 s mobile LCP, 88 KB main script, Works offline.
